body_markdown:
*Together with OLEDWorks, Recognizing a Decade of OLED Automotive Lighting Innovation and the Opportunities Ahead*


EWING, N.J. & INGOLSTADT, Germany–(BUSINESS WIRE)–


[Universal Display Corporation](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Foled.com%2F&esheet=54628684&newsitemid=20261026188956&lan=en-US&anchor=Universal+Display+Corporation&index=1&md5=205e97d65ca2f93be66fd85146916871) (UDC) (Nasdaq: OLED) and[Audi](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.audi.com%2F&esheet=54628684&newsitemid=20261026188956&lan=en-US&anchor=Audi&index=2&md5=040dece69b925d37ec084643005f5982) celebrated ten years of OLED technology in Audi production vehicles, marking a decade of innovation that has transformed OLED lighting into one of the automotive industry’s most distinctive, energy-efficient and technologically advanced lighting platforms. The announcement follows Audi’s event in Ingolstadt, Germany recognizing a decade of OLED technology across its vehicle portfolio. Together with OLEDWorks, the companies are highlighting how OLED automotive lighting has evolved and its growing role in the future of automotive design, functionality and communication.
